$comment: APP PROFILE TEMPLATE. Copy this folder to apps/<app-id>/ and replace every placeholder.
<app-id> is the folder name: lower-case letters, digits, - and _. Select it with --app <app-id> or APP=<app-id>.
appName            Display name. Used in the run banner, generated docs and LLM prompts.
appDescription     ONE line: what the app is for and who uses it. Fed to the doc/discovery LLM prompts.
baseUrl            Where the app runs. Every goto path in a flow is relative to it.
APP_URL in apps/<app-id>/.env may point at a preview build instead (still host-gated).
allowedHosts       The safety gate refuses any target host not listed here. Bare host names, no scheme.
writeAllowedHosts  Hosts where a DUMMY write flow may write. Usually just the test/staging host of the
dummy tenant. Must be a subset of allowedHosts. Empty = no writes anywhere.
repoPath           Optional local clone of the app repo, for the git-diff skip filter
(APP_REPO_PATH in .env overrides it). Empty = every flow runs every time.
repoBranch         Branch of that clone. Default main.
framework          Hint that switches framework-specific behaviour on: react-native-web (login fields are
typed key-by-key), nextjs, react, vue, angular, svelte, other.
theme              light | dark — the OS colour scheme the browser reports (COLOR_SCHEME overrides).
locale, timezone   What the emulated browser reports, so dates and numbers render as users see them.
docsAudience       Who generated docs are written for, e.g. 'a shop manager'.
loginAdapter       How to sign in. See the $comment inside it.
accounts           Identities flows can sign in as (flow `auth:`). Each names the .env variables holding
its login and its secret. `optional: true` skips that identity's flows (with a reason)
when its credentials are missing. The name `dummy` is reserved for the dummy account,
the ONLY identity that may ever write. `none` (signed-out) needs no entry.
defaultAccount     Identity a flow uses when it has no `auth:`. May not be `dummy`.
extraEnvVars       Other .env variables flows may use as {{NAME}} (e.g. a pinned record id). Never credentials.
dummyAccount       The dummy tenant's fingerprint and write-safety switches. See the $comment inside it.
interstitials      Selectors of nuisance overlays (cookie banner, nudge modal) dismissed before each tap.
discovery          Where `npm run discover` looks for navigation. See the $comment inside it.
dataIsolation: how this app keeps test data away from real records —
separate-project (own deployment AND database) | separate-tenant (a real tenant boundary) | none.
"none" is the default and refuses every write. A login is NOT isolation: a single-tenant app
cannot be "separate-tenant" however many accounts it has.
outboundKillSwitch: a dated human attestation that outbound messaging is OFF for this target,
e.g. { "email": "EMAIL_PROVIDER=dev", "verifiedOn": "2026-09-25" }. Writes are refused without it,
and so is any step declared `sends: true`. Synthetic @example.com addresses are data HYGIENE,
not a safety control: the app will still try to deliver to them.
appDescription: REPLACE ME — one line on what the app does and who uses it.
docsAudience: a person using the app for the first time

$comment: type: email-password | username-password | mobile-pin. Selectors are the app's own, ideally data-testid.
email-password     selectors: email, password, submit, signedIn (required); next, error (optional)
username-password  selectors: username, password, submit, signedIn (required); next, error (optional)
options:   loginPath ('/login'), homePath ('/'), typing ('fill' | 'sequential'), statusPattern
`next` is for two-step forms that reveal the password after a button press.
mobile-pin         selectors: phone, continue, pin, signedIn (required); mustChangePin (optional)
options:   countryCode (e.g. '1'), mobileDigits (10), pinDigits (4), loginPath ('/'),
registerUrlPattern (regex of the route an unknown number is sent to), statusPattern
signedIn is an element that exists ONLY when signed in (an account menu, the app shell header).

admin.description: A real account with full navigation. Permanently READ-ONLY.

dummy.description: The dummy account in its own separate test tenant. The only identity that may write.

$comment: A flow writes only when ALL hold: WRITE_MODE=dummy, the flow declares `writes: true` and `auth: dummy`,
the host is in writeAllowedHosts, and after sign-in the tenant id AND name read from the page equal
tenantId / tenantName below EXACTLY. Any mismatch aborts the run before the first action.
tenantIdProbe / tenantNameProbe: where to read them — { selector, attribute? } (attribute omitted = the
element's text) or { urlPattern } (a regex with one capture group, matched against the URL).
messagingSuppressed: true ONLY if the dummy tenant cannot send email/SMS/WhatsApp. A write flow that
declares `sends_messages` is skipped and flagged in the run report otherwise.
syntheticPhones: extra fake phone numbers write flows may type, beyond 555-01xx and repeated digits.
Leave tenantId / tenantName empty until the dummy tenant exists: write flows then refuse to run.
Each navSource: open `path`, read every control matching `items`, tap each (re-found by `role` +
accessible name) and record the route it opens. labelAttribute reads the label from an attribute;
labelCut cuts the label at the first of these characters ('Settings, 3' -> 'Settings').
Omit this section to read the tabs and nav links on '/'.
